plan.reason: With 10D and only 24/100 evaluations, a mid-size population (30) and few surrogate generations conserve the expensive budget while giving the auto surrogate enough samples to pick RBF vs quadratic. Stagnation at 6 with zero recent improvement indicates the search is stalling, so I raise exploration (0.45) relative to the reference plan to favor novelty over predicted-objective exploitation, keep a modest local fraction with a small radius for local refinement, and use current_to_best to balance convergence and diversity without premature collapse from best1.

With 10D and 44/100 evaluations, auto surrogate can choose between RBF and quadratic as the 44-point sample is reasonably informative (CV RMSE ~0.72). Recent improvement is strong (0.99 relative) and stagnation is 0, so the search is still productive; a moderate exploration (0.55) maintains diversity without abandoning exploitation. current_to_best balances convergence and diversity; mid population (32) and few surrogate generations (5) conserve the remaining budget while local_fraction 0.3 with radius 0.12 enables focused refinement.

With 10D and 64/100 evaluations, 36 true evaluations remain, so surrogate generation must stay cheap. CV normalized RMSE ~0.23 suggests the surrogate is usable, but the 64-point sample in 10D is still sparse, so 'auto' lets held-out RMSE pick RBF or quadratic. Stagnation of 10 with zero recent improvement signals a stalled local basin; current_to_best with moderate mutation and slightly reduced exploration (0.45) preserves some diversity to escape it without discarding exploitation. A smaller population (28) and 5 generations conserve budget, while local_fraction 0.25 and radius 0.10 focus refinement near the incumbent.

Only 16 true evaluations remain and the run is stagnant (30 stalled, zero recent improvement), so the plan must be cheap yet exploratory. Higher CV normalized RMSE (~0.42) indicates a weaker surrogate in 10D, so 'auto' still lets held-out RMSE arbitrate RBF vs quadratic rather than committing. Lower mutation (0.35) with current_to_best keeps search near the incumbent basin, while raised exploration (0.75) pushes new candidates toward novel regions to break stagnation. Small population (20) and 4 generations fit the residual budget; local_fraction 0.2 with radius 0.08 emphasizes local refinement over broad sampling given the limited evaluations.
